scripts.build:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:code-index && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/api run build:ts
scripts.test:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:code-index && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/api run test
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/web run build
scripts.build:mcp: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/mcp run build
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/cli run build
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch && pnpm version patch --filter @codemap-ai/cli --filter @codemap-ai/mcp --filter @codemap-ai/api --filter @codemap-ai/web --filter @codemap-ai/shared --no-git-tag-version
scripts.build:core: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:code-index && pnpm --filter @codemap-ai/core run build
